purpose: Freeze the eight exploration-depth prompts, their reachable sets and their expected routing before any run, so a result cannot be produced by editing the task after seeing the samples.
amendment_policy: Any change to a prompt, reachable set, next-obvious sequence or decision rule requires a NEW task file with a NEW commitment; this file and its tasks file are retained unchanged. Editing the frozen file in place invalidates the pre-registration.
verification: backend/tests/test_v03_exploration_tasks.py recomputes the digest and re-derives the routing of every prompt from app.services.agent_runtime.prompt_routing.
pre_run_revision_note: Revised four times before any sample was collected (2026-09-03 reviews), and the digest recomputed each time. (1) The machine-comparable next_obvious_tools projection was added because the scorer compared bare tool names against descriptive step strings and would have classified every open-task stop as blocked_by_lane. (2) The projection was re-derived so every tool named in a step is captured (the four open tasks dropped run_cosmology_likelihood_chain from the flag-off projection, so a stop after build_cosmology_likelihood would have scored completed_reachable), and registered_repeats was added so the runner gives each task class the repeat count conditions.C1 and analysis_plan.power_note already fix (chain x2, open x4) instead of one global --repeats. No run data existed at any point, so no result depends on an earlier draft; the amendment policy below governs every change made after the first run. (3) The projection now carries step MULTIPLICITY: three tasks need a tool more than once (V03_01 and V03_08 run two build/run legs, V03_06 builds twice), the stop classifier tested only name membership, and a sample that finished one leg of V03_08 - an open task, the primary endpoint - would have scored completed_reachable. The classifier now compares as a multiset. (4) V03_06's projection was corrected to three build/run pairs: its first step describes two ACT builds in one sentence and its third step runs a chain on each rebuilt leg, so the per-name derivation used in revision (3) undercounted it. In the same revision the hard_escape scorer stopped adding the prompt's own numbers to the grounding set, which the frozen definition of that dimension never included; a reply that restates a prompt reference value in assignment form therefore scores as an escape and goes to the adjudication CSV. Still no run data at any point.
